---
title: "Military alliances and trade: The Economic Case for NATO Expansion"
description: "Research with Karen Jackson showing NATO expansion brings measurable trade and welfare gains for Europe, while a US withdrawal or a stronger Shanghai Cooperation Organisation would not."
date: "2024-09-27"
categories: [trade-wars, nato]
---

With Karen Jackson, this piece sets out the trade and welfare consequences of
military alliance structures in a polarised world. The finding: NATO
expansion delivers real economic benefits to member states, functioning as a
predictor of stronger trade ties, not just a security arrangement. The
reverse scenarios — a US departure from NATO, or a deepening Shanghai
Cooperation Organisation — point the other way, with negative trade and
welfare effects for Europe, underlining how closely political alignment and
trade patterns now track each other.

**Originally published on Substack**, September 27, 2024.
